why_this_data.value: Sources chosen with highest Band 7 fluxes to maximise CO(1-0) detection

evidence.quote: To maximise the chances of detecting CO(1-0) emission, we selected the 16 galaxies with the highest ALMA Band 7 (343.5 GHz) fluxes.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Double Gaussian fits for sources 3 and 8 not adopted as unphysical

evidence.quote: We do not consider the double Gaussian profiles to be physical given the relative strengths of the rms and dip in flux.

limitations_admitted.value: Sample biased to high SFR; alpha_CO uncertainty up to factor ~8 dominates absolute masses

evidence.quote: Our sample is therefore intentionally biased to the types of high SFR ($\mathrm{SFR}>300\ensuremath{\rm{M}_{\odot}}\ensuremath{\rm{yr}^{-1}}$) sources
